text: Isn't it? And we're not asking for a lot, just some or all of your incoming payment for your task. It's going to a really good cause!

text: What kind of aid do they give?

text: They help provide water, give children access to education, give girls tampons so that they can attend school on their period, give them vaccines - things like that.

text: A couple of organizations claim to do that. Why should I donate to this one in particular?

speaker: A1LB9JOMFQ1UMG
text: You're right. A lot of organization collect funds and then it goes to administration or advertising and not a lot of money goes to the people who need it the most. speaker: A5NE8TWS8ZV7B
text: Is there any concrete proof that they do? Words are just words sometimes.

speaker: A1LB9JOMFQ1UMG
text: I totally understand that! They have a full list of the percentages that they spend on each thing at  URL so you can see exactly where your money is going!

text: Thank you so much for even taking the time to consider it!
